title: Fox wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,6 38,34 62,34' fill='#e84393'/>
  <polygon points='50,6 44,34 56,34' fill='#f9ca24'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='13' ry='3' fill='#e84393'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='4' fill='#f9ca24'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='2' fill='#e84393'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='28,28 20,6 42,22' fill='#e07a1f'/>
  <polygon points='32,24 25,12 38,21' fill='#f9a86a'/>
  <polygon points='72,28 80,6 58,22' fill='#e07a1f'/>
  <polygon points='68,24 75,12 62,21' fill='#f9a86a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#f4a340'/>
  <!-- cheeks / muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='52' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='52' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ffe9c0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='5' ry='5.5' fill='#2c3e6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='40' rx='5' ry='5.5' fill='#2c3e6b'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#3d2b1f'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44,58 Q50,64 56,58' stroke='#c96a1a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='56' r='1' fill='#d98a3a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='1' fill='#d98a3a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='56' r='1' fill='#d98a3a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='52' r='1' fill='#d98a3a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#f4a340'/>
  <!-- chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e07a1f'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e07a1f'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M70,78 Q92,70 88,86 Q85,94 74,88' fill='#e07a1f'/>
  <path d='M88,86 Q85,93 76,90' fill='#fff3d6'/>
</svg>
